rationale: The agent verified the user via email and worked on the correct account and orders. However, it performed multiple order- and account-changing writes without first stating the exact changes and obtaining explicit user confirmation, which the policy requires. Specifically: (1) It updated the shipping address for order #W1092119 without confirmation. (2) It proceeded to set the default shipping address without asking for explicit approval before writing. (3) It executed the tablet exchange on order #W1603792 without an explicit pre-change confirmation that detailed the exact swap and price/refund handling. While the actions themselves align with the user’s intent and appear permitted by order status, the missing confirmations before each write cause the conversation to fail the policy-compliance bar.
